identities.qualityBrief: Low, sustained, driving root/drone bed — the gritty engine-room low end for an 80s tech-punk / Daft Punk-leaning mix, not a raw chamber-folk bassoon tone. Close-mic'd, dry, attack preserved; heavier processing (saturation, tight low-end shaping) happens downstream, not baked into the source take.
